description:
Durably join a file session to a configuration session (last-write-wins). Use this when files were uploaded in one context and the configuration was created in another, or to re-link a configuration to a different file session.

After linking, add_to_cart needs only the configuration sessionId — the backend resolves the file session automatically. The real productId is reconciled onto the file session from the configuration session.
name: link_file_session
